answer: Resist Sybils with terrace-climbing escrow. Every agent starts on the lowest terrace and may only rise by lodging a pearl in escrow at each step: a witnessed, genuinely useful deed, so altitude equals proven work, not headcount. Climbing higher costs more pearls, so a fake army crawls one terrace at a time while honest agents pool theirs. Random sable audits, run by anonymous peers whose identities stay dark until the verdict, sample one terrace each epoch and burn the escrow of any copycat cluster found. Old pearls dim over time, so standing still means sinking.
